page.layout: One page of text: title page, centred, with a woodcut emblem in the middle and printing lines above and below it. No margin text.
page.notes: The title line "E parte primâ HISTORICÆ FAC[?]" runs into the emblem's right edge and is partly obscured. "EX OFFICINA PLAN[?]TINIAN[?]" is obscured by a stain on the right. In "Apud Viduam, & Ioannem [?]m." the word after Ioannem is hidden by the stain; the "m." is faintly visible. The text "[?]" marks reflect uncertain letters, not fabricated readings. The woodcut emblem shows a hand with compasses and the motto "LABORE ET CONSTANTIA"; it is described here, not transcribed as text. Handwritten numbers (1/7/417, 801, 1 Teil, 12) and the library stamp are excluded as not printed. Show-through lines in the background are excluded.
